# portvmind_vke_node_group (Resource)

Creates, updates, or deletes a worker node group on a VKE cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "portvmind_vke_node_group" "workers_2" {
  cluster_id       = portvmind_vke_cluster.main.id
  name             = "workers-2"
  node_flavor_uuid = "<node_flavor_uuid>"
  node_disk_size   = 50
  min_size         = 1
  max_size         = 4

  # node_group_labels = [
  #   "workload=gpu",
  #   "team=ml",
  # ]
  # node_group_taints = [
  #   "dedicated=worker2:NoSchedule",
  # ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Parent cluster UUID.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum number of nodes.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of nodes.
- `name` (String) Node group name (max 20 characters).
- `node_disk_size` (Number) Node disk size in GB.
- `node_flavor_uuid` (String) PortvMind Cloud flavor ID.

### Optional

- `node_group_labels` (List of String) Kubernetes labels (e.g. key=value). If empty, the API default applies.
- `node_group_taints` (List of String) Kubernetes taints (key=value:Effect).

### Read-Only

- `current_nodes` (Number) Current number of nodes.
- `id` (String) Node group UUID.
- `status` (String) Node group status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import portvmind_vke_node_group.workers_2 <cluster_uuid>/<node_group_uuid>
```
